baseline_prompt_en: Create a natural vertical classroom portrait of the same fictional 18-year-old Korean high-school senior shown in the attached reference image. She leans gently until one cheek rests in clear contact with the raised knee and looks directly into the camera with a quiet, intent expression. Her torso curls slightly around the knee; both hands loosely circle the raised shin, leaving the cheek-to-knee contact visible. Retain the reference's long straight dark hair, airy bangs, large brown eyes, soft pink lips, navy blazer, white shirt, plaid ribbon bow, dark pleated skirt, knee-high socks, and loafers. Frame her from head to both shoes in a vertical composition, with the elevated foot, bent knee, cheek contact, and grounded foot all readable at once. Use a clean green chalkboard, warm window light, realistic fabric folds, natural skin detail, and a calm after-class atmosphere.
